title: The Letter Shift Matrix
description:
A cipher slip was recovered from a locked filing cabinet.
The encryption alternates between +1 and -1 shifts.
question: Decrypt 'U G F R F U' (odd positions +1, even positions -1):
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the hidden word.

Example:
SECRET
hints: Reverse shifts: 1st letter U (-1) -> T? S (+1)->T. For U -> S! G (+1) -> H? G (+1) -> H -> E! So SECRET.
solution_explanation: Reversing the alternating shift (+1 on odd positions, -1 on even positions) on 'U G F R F U' yields 'SECRET'.
